cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallTypeTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Type tray - allows only continuous walls
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallTypeTray --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --bottom_edge s --walltype 'french cleat' --back_height 60 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallTypeTray --bottom_edge --walltype --back_height --reference --labels
